approvers: Site manager and project/contracts manager; I sign
reason: I pay about €12 a m² today with my own labour and film. This is €19, which is over half as much again, and I still carry the risk if it marks the frame or glass. Convenience is nice but not at that premium on a margin I watch job by job.
objection: If the coating marks the frame or the coated glass when it comes off, who pays? The manufacturer excludes it, so I would carry the risk and pay 58% more for the privilege.
instead: Keep using self-adhesive film and sheet applied and removed by my own labour.
would_change_my_mind: ACHV or their insurer accepting written liability for damage to frames and glass on removal, plus a price close to €13-14 per m² all-in and a local reference from a contractor my size.
